segments.name: Acquisition, exploration and evaluation of mineral properties
segments.description: A mineral exploration and evaluation company advancing copper-nickel-cobalt-platinum group elements mines in Botswana.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in one reportable operating segment, being that of the acquisition, exploration and evaluation of mineral properties, in three geographic segments, being Canada, Barbados, and Botswana.

changes.text: In 2025, the Company changed its name from Premium Resources Ltd. to NexMetals Mining Corp.
changes.evidence: On June 9, 2025, the Company announced that it changed its name from "Premium Resources Ltd." to "NexMetals Mining Corp."
